plugin.name: Sonic Heroes Widescreen Fix
MAIN.WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window or borderless. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.WindowResize.description: Lets the framed window be resized. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.BorderlessScaling.description: Cover the monitor, fit the chosen aspect ratio inside it, or keep the chosen resolution in a centered borderless window. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.ResX.description: Width in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.ResY.description: Height in pixels. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.MinAspectRatio.description: Below this aspect ratio the view zooms out so nothing is cut off on narrow screens.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. The HUD is not changed.
MISC.CustomUserFilesDirectoryInGameDir: Save folder in the game folder
MISC.CustomUserFilesDirectoryInGameDir.d: 0 keeps the game's own save location; a relative folder such as save keeps saves and settings next to the game.
MISC.ShadowScale.description: Size of the character shadows. 1.7 matches the GameCube version; 1.0 is the original PC size.
GRAPHICS.ShadowResolution.description: Resolution of the shadow map. The original uses 256.
MISC.ClipRange.description: Camera clipping range. Only used when Clip_Range is 3 in sonic_h.ini.
MISC.FixLensFlare.description: Scales the lens flare effect to the screen size.
MISC.FixAdvertiseWindows.description: Corrects the window sizes of the Extras (Advertise) menu.
MISC.FixStaffRoll.description: Corrects the staff roll at the end of the game.
MISC.DisableCDCheck.description: Lets the retail game run without its disc.
MISC.DisableMouseInput.description: Turns off mouse input, so a stray click or move doesn't affect the game.
MISC.DisableFrameSkipping.description: Draws every frame instead of skipping frames when the game falls behind.
MISC.DisableQuitDialog.description: Closes the game without asking when the window is closed (Alt+F4 or the close button).
MISC.DisableLoadingTimer.description: Removes the minimum display time of the loading screens.
MISC.RestoreDemos.description: Restores the attract demos on the title screen of the retail game.
MISC.IncreaseObjectDistance.description: Shows objects from farther away, reducing pop-in. Tuned by the minimum object distance and the distance scale.
MISC.ObjDistanceScale.description: Multiplier for the object visibility distance.
MISC.WarpSwitchEffectMode.description: Light effect when a castle or mansion switch is hit.
MISC.BetterFrameSync.description: A frame limiter with steadier frame times. The game speed follows the frame rate limit.
MISC.FPSLimitMode.description: 0 turns limiting off, 1 waits actively, 2 sleeps and yields.
MAIN.FPSLimit.description: Frame rate limit of the better frame pacing; the game speed is tied to it. 60 is normal speed.
SkipFE.Enabled.description: Starts the game in the system mode below.
SkipFE.SystemMode.description: Starting mode: 0 TV standard select, 1 main menu, 2 in game, 3 easy menu, 4 credits, 5 movie player.
SkipFE.Stage.description: Stage that starts when the system mode is in game.
SkipFE.Team1.description: First player team: -1 none, 0 Sonic, 1 Dark, 2 Rose, 3 Chaotix, 4 editor.
SkipFE.Team2.description: Second player team: -1 none, 0 Sonic, 1 Dark, 2 Rose, 3 Chaotix, 4 editor.
SkipFE.Team3.description: Third player team: -1 none, 0 Sonic, 1 Dark, 2 Rose, 3 Chaotix, 4 editor.
SkipFE.Team4.description: Fourth player team: -1 none, 0 Sonic, 1 Dark, 2 Rose, 3 Chaotix, 4 editor.
SkipFE.Movie.description: Movie that plays when the system mode is the movie player (-1 = default).
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the active game window. Releases it on focus loss, while moving the window or using a system menu, and immediately when disabled.
